messages.subject: Instructions to advise & settle - Ashfield Dynamics v Marwick Drives
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Harriet,

Please find our draft Particulars of Claim attached for your settling, together with the schedule of loss (total £418,500). We'd be grateful for your view on merits, on the clause 11 limitation under UCTA, and on a realistic settlement range. We aim to issue the week of 7 April.

Kind regards
Elena Marchetti

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Instructions to advise & settle - Ashfield Dynamics v Marwick Drives
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

The Particulars are in good shape - I've made a few drafting tweaks to the breach paragraphs which I'll return. Merits on liability are strong. Clause 11 is the live risk; I'd put our prospects of defeating or reading it down at around 60-65%. A full opinion to follow once I've seen the expert report, but I'd be advising the client to aim for a settlement of roughly £290k-£315k plus costs and not to go below about £275k.

Harriet
